name: tributary
description: Apache Kafka integration for DuckDB. Scan topics directly into queries, consume specific partitions and offsets, run analytics over streaming data, and optionally write back. SQL-native pipeline between DuckDB and Kafka.

cta.title: Kafka in SQL
cta.description: Install Tributary to read Kafka topics as DuckDB tables — point queries at a topic, JOIN with local data, and write processed records back to Kafka.

quickStart:
-- Scan an entire Kafka topic
SELECT *
FROM tributary_scan_topic('test-topic',
                          "bootstrap.servers" := 'localhost:9092');
